artworks.title: La Ciotat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal view with a rocky beach in the lower right corner. In the distance, there is a town beside a calm body of water. Rolling hills or low mountains form the horizon, with buildings along the shoreline. The image is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: La Ciotat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal town seen from the shoreline, with a rocky beach in the foreground. The bay sweeps towards the horizon, with the sky and water prominent in the frame. Hills or large rock formations emerge in the distance, and a stone pier juts into the water, featuring a small lighthouse. The town sits along the shoreline, with buildings of different sizes and a walled structure. The color scheme appears monochromatic like an early photograph, creating a timeless ambiance. The scene conveys a sense of tranquility with smooth transitions between land, water, and sky layers.

artworks.title: Columbia from the Capitol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a landscape with ruins of a city. There are scattered large stone blocks, remnants of machinery, and a wooden fence marking a boundary. A deserted street leads into the distance, surrounded by charred and skeletal remains of buildings. Trees and faint structures can be seen on the horizon. The sky is filled with large clouds, casting somber light over the scene. The photograph's monochromatic palette emphasizes the contrast between sky and ruins.

artworks.title: Orchard Knob from Mission Ridge
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10 x 14 in. (25.4 x 35.6 cm)
support: 41 x 51.1 cm (16 1/8 x 20 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape framed by two trees. In the foreground, there are two trees with textured bark, branches, and leaves. The background depicts a distant horizon with hills and flat terrain. The image has a monochromatic sepia tone, with a color palette of browns and grays. The landscape in the background is blurred, emphasizing the tree details in the foreground.

artworks.title: Rain Sculpture, Salt Creek Canon, Utah
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a geological formation with towering rock structures and sharp, vertical lines resembling cliffs. The horizon is high in the composition, defined by uneven hilltops meeting the sky. Dark treetops punctuate the horizon. The tonal palette is sepia, giving an antique quality to the photograph. In the distance, ridged formations continue, while closer rocks are interspersed with sparse shrubs and shadows.

artworks.title: Construction of Rock and Brush Dam, L[ow]. W[ater]. 1891
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a construction site by a body of water, with workers laboring on a structure made of stones and logs at the water's edge. In the background, a range of hills covered in foliage can be seen. The scene is captured from a slightly elevated angle, with a cyanotype color palette emphasizing different shades of blue. The workers are depicted engaged in various tasks, conveying human activity and teamwork in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Levee at Rapids City, Illinois
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline with icy water, a high horizon line, distant land, small buildings on the right, a cyanotype style with blue tones, and vegetation leading to the frozen shoreline.

artworks.title: Femme Malgache et Ses Enfants (Madagascan Woman and Her Children) (Plate 3)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows four people standing closely together in a group. They are facing the camera with their eyes directed towards the viewer. The person on the far right has their arm around the person next to them. Each person has distinct facial features and hairstyles. The woman in the center has her hair styled in circular patterns and wears a long, patterned gown with layers, and seems to be holding the shoulder of the person beside her. The other three individuals, who appear to be younger, are dressed in lighter shades with loose-fitting shirts, pants, or skirts, all also patterned. The background is blurred, with a faint outline of foliage or a tree on the left and a structure further back on the right, against an open sky. None of the subjects are wearing jewelry or holding any objects.

artworks.title: Les Femmes Malgaches (Plate 28)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Three individuals are shown standing outdoors in a triangular arrangement. Their torsos are bare and wrapped with patterned cloths around their waists. The individual in the center faces forward while the others face each other. They have short, naturally textured hair. The center figure wears a necklace. There is a wooden building with a large door in the background, and the ground is bare earth.

artworks.title: Trois Femmes Malgaches (Plate 30)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing close together. They are dressed in a way that obscures their facial features, but their short, curly hair is visible. One person wears a necklace. The individuals are positioned in front of a wooden structure with a large door, suggesting an outdoor setting. The lighting is subdued, giving the photograph a sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Hermit's Woods, or the Banks of Lake Trasimène (Le Bois de l'Hermite, ou les Bords du Lac Trasimène)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint overlooking a landscape with dense trees, an open sky, and a low horizon. There is a small structure or object near the horizon line, partially hidden by trees. The drawing style is sketch-like, with cross-hatched lines creating texture. Trees are depicted with intricate, overlapping lines, while the sky is suggested by horizontal strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark sepia or brown tones creating contrast between detailed elements and more open areas.

artworks.title: Marsh at Piat (Belle-Croix Plateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water surrounded by dense trees. The horizon is blocked by a line of trees in the center, their reflections visible in the water. The color palette is sepia, creating a tranquil atmosphere. Sparse vegetation and rocks can be seen in the water, adding to the rustic feel. The scene is calm, with gentle contrasts and depth enhanced by the lighting.

artworks.title: Marsh at Piat (Belle-Croix Plateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pond with a wooded area in the background. Trees surround the pond, their reflections visible on the water's surface. The horizon is above the middle of the image, marked by a line of trees. Rocks and grass are close to the viewer, leading to the pond. The image has a monochromatic color palette with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Près du Bodmer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large tree with a massive trunk and thick, twisting branches extending in various directions. The horizon is not visible, focusing solely on the tree and surrounding vegetation. The branches fill the frame with a network of limbs and leaves, displaying a soft, grainy texture. The color palette is primarily sepia, creating a warm, vintage tone. The foreground has dense undergrowth, and the background features more trees blending into the haze.

artworks.title: Kalaat-El-Hosn, Deuxième Enciente, Extérieur, Tour d'Angle, sud-ouest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large stone fortress-like structure with a tall cylindrical tower alongside connected walls. The view is from a slightly lower angle, emphasizing the height of the tower. The composition is dominated by the structure, with well-arranged stone blocks showing signs of age, wear, and vegetation growth. The color palette is in soft sepia tones, giving an aged feel. The sky is clear and takes up a significant portion of the background, highlighting the stone structure.

artworks.title: Full Moon
artworks.dimensions:
overall: 8.3 × 17.2 cm (3 1/4 × 6 3/4 in.)
image (each): 5.8 cm (2 5/16 in.) diameter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: Two nearly identical black and white images of the lunar surface are encased in round openings in a rectangular, red holder. The edges of the holder are wrapped with tape or other material in a similar red color. The photographs are to either side of decorations and text in gold that create a vertical line up the center, between the photographs. Text along the top reads, “LUNAR PHOTOGRAPHS BY WARREN DE LA RUE F.R.S. Pres RAS.” An ornament like a downward pointing fleur-de-lis is printed beneath the text. An identical ornament pointing upward is placed above the bottom text which reads, “ENLARGED AND PUBLISHED BY SMITH BECK & BECK LONDON.” Each text block is enclosed by triangular shapes with inward curving sides and points that meet in the middle between the images of the moon.

artworks.title: The Arctic Regions: No. 36. The Glacier As Seen Flowing Or Being Forced Down Between The Hills, Ploughing Up A Moraine Of Earth And Rocks, Twenty To Thirty Feet High
artworks.artist: John L. Dunmore, and George P. Critcherson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with rocky terrain leading to a body of water and a distant landmass. The horizon is seen high in the image, with a rocky ridge spanning the width. Ice formations are visible on the water. Various textures on the rocks and soil can be seen, with different hues in the earth and snow remnants. The color palette is muted, focusing on earth tones and grayscale shades. The absence of bright colors gives the impression of a cold, desolate environment. The scene evokes a sense of isolated beauty and natural elements.

artworks.title: The Arctic Regions: No. 92.* The Devil's Thumb partially enveloped in a fog, with the first of the drift Ice from the pack, which was being forced towards the land, from which we escaped through a narrow lead; had we been hemmed in, we should have had to winter there
artworks.artist: John L. Dunmore, and George P. Critcherson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a cold, icy landscape with floating ice chunks on still water. Larger ice formations extend towards dark, jagged mountains that meet an overcast sky. The color palette is primarily muted browns and grays. The scene appears to be a photograph capturing intricate details and tonal gradations, with calm atmosphere and soft contrasts between the ice, water, and sky.

artworks.title: Rostral Column
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a stone column with a decorative capital, set against a blurred architectural backdrop. The image captures a classical stone column, intricately carved, with the upper part of the column featuring an ornate capital. The focus is mainly on the column itself with the background showing a building facade, slightly out of focus. The sepia tones of the photograph lend an antique feel to the entire scene.

artworks.title: Microphotograph of Traverse Section of Wood (Salisburia)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image displays a large circle filled with an intricate pattern of dotted lines and small, speckled details, forming a dense texture. The abstract composition resembles a microscopic view of a woven fabric or a cross-section of a geological sample, highlighting the minute and repetitive nature of the shapes within. The manifold tiny dots and lines in addition to the circular shape suggest a similarity to the surface of a planet or a celestial body as seen from a distance.

artworks.title: Gnarled-Thorn Trees
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. A line of trees stretches horizontally across the middle of the composition. The barren trees contrast against a flat horizon. The brushstrokes create a soft texture resembling early photographic styles. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and brown. In the distance, the land appears covered in snow or frost, blending into the sky. Close to us, the surface appears slightly darker.

artworks.title: The Poacher-A Hare in View
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile holding a greyhound by the hindquarters. The man is wearing a flat cap, a long dark jacket over a shirt, dark trousers, and sturdy footwear. An object is tucked into his coat. In the background, there is a textured landscape fading into a vast, open sky with a slightly overcast appearance.

artworks.title: A Sharpshooter's Last Sleep, Gettysburg, Pennsylvania
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white photograph of a war-torn landscape with a fallen figure on the ground. The scene is characterized by rough terrain of rocks and muddy, uneven earth. In the center of the image, a figure is lying flat among the grass and dirt, with a gun laying on the ground next to them. They have light skin, dark hair, and a dark jacket open to show a white shirt. There are many shapes in the background that could be other bodies or the remnants of clothing or belongings.

artworks.title: School Street, Boston
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a bustling urban street scene from the past. The image features a cobblestone street lined with tall, narrow brick buildings with multiple stories. Each building displays large signs advertising various businesses, such as a medical college, law offices, and book stores. The street is filled with movement as carriages, presumably horse-drawn, travel up and down the road alongside parked vehicles. Awnings extend over the sidewalk. The architecture reflects a historical era with its uniform windows, chimneys, and intricate facades, adding to the overall charm of the scene. The photograph captures a busy commercial district during that time.
